places.name: Republican River
places.note: The hide wagon eventually reaches it after weeks of rain, hail and bogging on the open plain.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Elmira drives a mule wagon of hides across its northern plains; Luke harasses her until Zwey smashes his head on a wheel.

places.name: Fort where Elmira joined the hide hunters
places.note: Starting point of the trip; Luke won card money there, and they have seen nobody since leaving it.
places.location_hint: a fort in Kansas, south of the Republican River, some weeks' wagon travel from Ogallala

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Elmira imagines Dee Boot telling her she should have gone back there and found work through the girls.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Luke complains it is still a long way off and he can't wait that long.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Their destination; frightened by the unknown rifleman, Elmira longs to get there.

groups.label: Elmira with the hide hunters
groups.hint: on the plains of northern Kansas, around the Republican River, travelling north toward Ogallala
